items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Go by Mullees [? (spelling)] and stand up there let everybody order drinks on you.

ctx.x: Go by Mullees [? (spelling)] and stand up there let everybody order drinks on you. Somebody pull his coat, say, “Don’t go in there no more.” Now you can talk about the man, but all of that goes with music.
In New Orleans, before you left town, it was really hard, no matter . . . even if you had a big name among the musicians and more popular, it was hard to really make it.
